turns.content: The strongest setups are repeat offenders rather than new listings. I’m ranking for probability × potential funding depth, so some currently cooler names with sustained, severe episode histories rank above warmer coins whose history is mostly shallow touches. Probabilities are anchored to the 10.7% overall quiet-coin base rate and the roughly 29–38% rates for frequent repeat offenders; borrow constraints are inferred unless an announcement supports them.
